name: Fortifying Brew
description: Turns your skin to stone for 15 sec.

name: Invoke Niuzao, the Black Ox
description: Summons an effigy of Niuzao, the Black Ox for 25 sec that attacks your primary target and Stomps when you cast Blackout Kick, damaging all nearby enemies.\n\nWhile active, 40% of damage delayed by Stagger is instead Staggered by Niuzao, and Niuzao is healed for 100% of your purified Stagger.

name: Exploding Keg
description: Hurls a flaming keg at the target location, dealing 133 Fire damage to nearby enemies, causing your attacks against them to deal 10 additional Fire damage, and causing their melee attacks to deal 100% reduced damage for the next 3 sec.\n\nResets the cooldown of Keg Smash.

name: Paralysis
description: Incapacitates the target for 1 min. Limit 1. Damage may cancel the effect.

name: Tiger's Lust
description: Increases a friendly target's movement speed by 70% for 6 sec and removes all roots and snares.

name: Breath of Fire
description: Breathe fire on targets in front of you, causing 35 Fire damage. Deals reduced damage to secondary targets.\n\nTargets affected by Keg Smash will also burn, taking 23 Fire damage and dealing 5% reduced damage to you for 12 sec.

name: Spear Hand Strike
description: Jabs the target in the throat, interrupting spellcasting and preventing any spell from that school of magic from being cast for 5 sec.

name: Summon Black Ox Statue
description: Summons a Black Ox Statue at the target location for 15 min, pulsing threat to all enemies within 20 yards.\n\nYou may cast Provoke on the statue to taunt all enemies near the statue.

name: Transcendence
description: Split your body and spirit, leaving your spirit behind for 15 min. Use Transcendence: Transfer to swap locations with your spirit.

name: Keg Smash
description: Smash a keg of brew, dealing 98 Physical damage to your primary target and 67 Physical damage to all other enemies within 8 yds, and reducing their movement speed by 20% for 15 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.

name: Purifying Brew
description: Clears 50% of your Staggered damage, or a minimum of 8% of your maximum health.

name: Detox
description: Removes all Poison and Disease effects from the target.

name: Diffuse Magic
description: Activating Fortifying Brew transfers all currently active harmful magical effects on you back to their original caster if possible.

name: Soothing Mist
description: Heals the target for 6,386 over 7.1 sec. While channeling, Enveloping Mist and Vivify may be cast instantly on the target.

name: Black Ox Brew
description: Chug some Black Ox Brew, which instantly refills your Energy, Purifying Brew charges, and grants one charge of Celestial Brew or Celestial Infusion.

name: Ring of Peace
description: Form a Ring of Peace at the target location for 5 sec. Enemies that enter will be ejected from the Ring.

name: Chi Burst
description:
Hurls a torrent of Chi energy up to 40 yds forward, dealing 98 Nature damage to all enemies, and 75 healing to the Monk and all allies in its path. Healing and damage reduced beyond 5 targets.


Casting Chi Burst does not prevent avoiding attacks.

name: Song of Chi-Ji
description: Conjures a cloud of hypnotic mist that slowly travels forward. Enemies touched by the mist fall asleep, Disoriented for 20 sec.

name: Rushing Jade Wind
description: Summons a whirling tornado around you, causing 41 Physical damage over 5.4 sec to all enemies within 8 yards. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.

name: Celestial Brew
description: A swig of strong brew that coalesces purified chi escaping your body into a celestial guard, absorbing 793 damage.

name: Celestial Infusion
description: A strong herbal brew that coalesces purified chi escaping your body into a celestial guard, absorbing 30% of incoming damage, up to 794 total.

name: Chi Torpedo
description: Torpedoes you forward a long distance and increases your movement speed by 30% for 10 sec, stacking up to 2 times.

name: Disable
description: Reduces the target's movement speed by 50% for 15 sec, duration refreshed by your melee attacks.

name: Touch of Death
description: You exploit the enemy target's weakest point, instantly dealing damage equal to 100% of your maximum health to them.\n\nOnly usable on creatures that have less health than you.

name: Touch of Fatality
description: Instantly kills any creature under level 50, or player under 20% health.

name: Leg Sweep
description: Knocks down all enemies within 6 yards, stunning them for 3 sec.

name: Zen Pilgrimage
description: Your spirit travels to your home temple, leaving your body behind. \n\nUse Zen Pilgrimage again to return back to near your departure point.

name: Expel Harm
description: Expel negative chi from your body, healing for 467 and dealing 10% of the amount healed as Nature damage to an enemy within 20 yards.

name: Provoke
description: Taunts the target to attack you, and increases the threat you generate against them by 800% for 6 sec.

name: Blackout Kick
description: Kick with a blast of Chi energy, dealing 30 Physical damage.

name: Roll
description: Roll a short distance.

name: Chi Wave
description: Every 15 sec, your next Rising Sun Kick or Vivify releases a wave of Chi energy that flows through friends and foes, dealing 6 Nature damage or 20 healing. Bounces up to 7 times to targets within 25 yards.

name: Crackling Jade Lightning
description: Channel Jade lightning, causing 9 Nature damage over 3.6 sec to the target and sometimes knocking back melee attackers.

name: Fists of Fury
description: Pummels all targets in front of you, dealing 456 Physical damage to your primary target and 274 damage to all other enemies over 3.6 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets. Can be channeled while moving.

name: Flying Serpent Kick
description: Soar forward through the air at high speed for 1.5 sec.\n \nIf used again while active, you will land, reducing the movement speed of enemies within 8 yds by 70% for 4 sec.

name: Healing Sphere
description: When you kill an enemy, you summon a Healing Sphere, healing you for 69 when you walk through it.

name: Renewing Mist
description: Surrounds the target with healing mists, restoring 837 health over 20 sec.\n\nIf Renewing Mist heals a target past maximum health, it will travel to another injured ally within 20 yds.

name: Resuscitate
description: Returns the spirit to the body, restoring a dead target to life with 35% of maximum health and mana. Cannot be cast when in combat.

name: Sheilun's Gift
description: Draws in all nearby clouds of mist generated by Sheilun, healing the target for 190 per cloud absorbed.

name: Single-Button Assistant
description: Casts damaging abilities for use in combat, rotating through them based on priority.\n\nThe global cooldown of abilities used through the Single-Button Assistant is 25% longer.

name: Spinning Crane Kick
description: Spin while kicking in the air, dealing 14 Physical damage over 1.3 sec to all enemies within 8 yds. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.

name: Tiger Palm
description: Strike with the palm of your hand, dealing 31 Physical damage.

name: Touch of Karma
description: Absorbs all damage taken for 10 sec, up to 50% of your maximum health, and redirects 70% of that amount to the enemy target as Nature damage over 6 sec.

name: Vivify
description: Causes a surge of invigorating mists, healing the target for 959.

name: Zen Flight
description: You fly through the air at a quick speed on a meditative cloud.

name: Zen Pilgrimage/Death Gate/Moonglade Storage Aura I
Zen Pilgrimage: Return
description: Returns your spirit back to its body, returning you near to where you once were.\n\nLeaving Peak of Serenity will cancel Zen Pilgrimage: Return.

name: Nimble Brew
description: Douse allies in the targeted area with Nimble Brew, preventing the next full loss of control effect within 8 sec.

name: Avert Harm
description: Guard the 4 closest players within 15 yards for 15 sec, allowing you to Stagger 20% of damage they take.

name: Double Barrel
description: Your next Keg Smash deals 50% additional damage, and stuns all targets it hits for 3 sec.

name: Mighty Ox Kick
description: You perform a Mighty Ox Kick, hurling your enemy a distance behind you.

name: Admonishment
description: You focus the assault on this target, increasing their damage taken by 3% for 6 sec. Each unique player that attacks the target increases the damage taken by an additional 3%, stacking up to 5 times.\n\nYour melee attacks refresh the duration of Focused Assault.

name: Dematerialize
description: Demateralize into mist while stunned, reducing damage taken by 30%. Each second you remain stunned reduces this bonus by 10%.

name: Eerie Fermentation
description: You gain up to 30% movement speed  and 15% magical damage reduction based on your current level of Stagger.

name: Hot Trub
description: Purifying Brew deals 20% of cleared damage split among nearby enemies. After clearing 100% of your maximum health in Stagger damage, your next Breath of Fire incapacitates targets for 4 sec.

name: Microbrew
description: Reduces the cooldown of Fortifying Brew by 50%.

name: Niuzao's Essence
description: Drinking a Purifying Brew, Celestial Brew, Fortifying Brew, or casting Roll will dispel all snares affecting you.

name: Transcendence: Linked Spirits
description: Transcendence now tethers your spirit onto an ally for 1 hour. Use Transcendence: Transfer to teleport to your ally's location.

name: Against All Odds
description: Your agility is increased by 4%.

name: Ancient Arts
description: Reduces the cooldown of Paralysis by 15 sec and the cooldown of Leg Sweep by 10 sec.

name: Anvil and Stave
description: Each time you dodge or an enemy misses you, the remaining cooldown on your Brews is reduced by 0.5 sec. Effect reduced by 50% for each additional recent attacker, up to 5.

name: Aspect of Harmony
description: Store vitality from 10% of your damage dealt and 30% of your healing.\n\nFor 10 sec after casting Thunder Focus Tea your spells and abilities draw upon the stored vitality to deal 40% additional healing over 8 sec.

name: August Blessing
description: When you would be healed above maximum health, you instead convert an amount equal to 40% of your critical strike chance to a heal over time effect.

name: Awakening Spirit
description: Purifying Brew also surrounds you with protective energies for 15 sec. \n\nWhen Staggered damage would be dealt to you, you instead absorb up to 50%, until 210 has been prevented.

name: Balanced Stratagem
description: Casting a Physical spell or ability increases the damage and healing of your next Fire or Nature spell or ability by 3%, and vice versa. Stacks up to 5.

name: Blackout Combo
description:
Blackout Kick also empowers your next ability:

 Tiger Palm: Damage increased by 100%.

 Keg Smash: Reduces the remaining cooldown on your Brews by 2 additional sec.

name: Bob and Weave
description: Increases the duration of Stagger by 5.0 sec, causing Staggered damage to be dealt to you more gradually.

name: Bounding Agility
description: Roll and Chi Torpedo travel a small distance further.

name: Bring Me Another
description: Drinking a Brew has a 20% chance to leave you with an Empty Barrel, which is tossed along with your next Keg Smash to deal 105 Physical damage to your target. Ricochets up to 4 times at 80% effectiveness.

name: Calming Presence
description: Reduces all damage taken by 3%.

name: Celerity
description: Reduces the cooldown of Roll by 5 sec and increases its maximum number of charges by 1.

name: Celestial Determination
description: While your Celestial is active, you cannot be slowed below 90% normal movement speed.

name: Celestial Flames
description:
Drinking from Brews has a 30% chance to coat you with Celestial Flames for 6 sec. While Celestial Flames is active:

 Special Delivery:
Kegs thrown by Special Delivery are ignited and splash upon landing, dealing 35 Fire damage to up to 5 nearby enemies.

 Rushing Jade Wind:
Rushing Jade Wind becomes a firestorm, increasing its radius by 30% and causing it to deal Fire damage.

name: Charred Passions
description: Your Breath of Fire ignites your right leg in flame for 8 sec, causing your Blackout Kick and Spinning Crane Kick to deal 50% additional damage as Fire damage and refresh the duration of your Breath of Fire on the target.

name: Chi Proficiency
description: Magical damage done increased by 5% and healing done increased by 5%.

name: Chi Transfer
description: Touch of Death now heals you for 50% of its damage done.

name: Clarity of Purpose
description: Casting Enveloping Mist stores 1,140 additional vitality.

name: Coalescence
description:
When Aspect of Harmony heals, it has a chance to spread to a nearby ally. When you directly heal an affected target, it has a chance to intensify, withdrawing additional vitality to increase its effect by up to 20%.

Vivify no longer contributes vitality. While Aspect of Harmony is not active, Vivify instead draws on available vitality to deal an additional 100% healing over 8 sec.

Vitality stored by other abilities is increased by 50%.

name: Combat Stance
description: The cooldown of Roll is decreased by 10%.

name: Counterstrike
description: Each time you dodge or an enemy misses you, your next Tiger Palm or Spinning Crane Kick deals 100% increased damage.

name: Crashing Momentum
description: Targets you Roll through are snared by 40% for 5 sec.

name: Dance of the Wind
description: Your dodge chance is increased by 5%.

name: Dragonfire Brew
description: Breath of Fire deals 100% increased damage, and after using Breath of Fire, you breathe fire 2 additional times, each dealing 7 Fire damage.

name: Efficient Training
description: Energy spenders deal an additional 20% damage.\nThe cooldown of Invoke Niuzao, the Black Ox is reduced by 25 sec.

name: Elixir of Determination
description: When you fall below 40% health, you gain an absorb for 30% of your recently Purified damage, or a minimum of 8% of your maximum health. Cannot occur more than once every 15 sec.

name: Elusive Footwork
description: Blackout Kick deals an additional 5% damage. Blackout Kick critical hits grant an additional 1 stack of Elusive Brawler.

name: Elusive Mists
description: Reduces all damage taken by you and your target while channeling Soothing Mists by 6%.

name: Empty the Cellar
description: Exploding Keg can be reactivated within 20 sec to throw 5 additional kegs at nearby targets, each dealing 70 Physical damage and reducing the cooldown of your Brews by 3.0 sec.

name: Endless Draught
description: Thunder Focus Tea has 1 additional charge.

name: Energy Transfer
description: Successfully interrupting an enemy reduces the cooldown of Paralysis and Roll by 5 sec.

name: Escape from Reality
description: After you use Transcendence: Transfer, you can use Transcendence: Transfer again within 10 sec, ignoring its cooldown.

name: Expeditious Fortification
description: Fortifying Brew cooldown reduced by 30 sec.

name: Face Palm
description: Tiger Palm's damage is increased by 100% and reduces the remaining cooldown of your Brews by 0.5 additional sec.

name: Fast Feet
description: Blackout Kick deals 20% increased damage. Spinning Crane Kick deals 10% additional damage.

name: Fatal Touch
description: Touch of Death's cooldown is reduced by 90 sec.

name: Ferocity of Xuen
description: Increases all damage dealt by 2%.

name: Flow of Chi
description:
You gain a bonus effect based on your current health.

Above 90% health: Movement speed increased by 5%. This bonus stacks with similar effects.

Between 90% and 35% health: Damage taken reduced by 5%.

Below 35% health: Healing received increased by 10%.

name: Fluidity of Motion
description: Blackout Kick's cooldown is reduced by 1 sec.

name: Flurry Strikes
description: Your auto attacks have a chance to generate 1-2 Flurry Charges. When you cast Keg Smash, unleash all Flurry Charges, dealing 21 Physical damage per charge.

name: Fortifying Brew: Determination
description: Fortifying Brew increases Stagger effectiveness by 15% while active.\n\nCombines with other Fortifying Brew effects.

name: Fuel on the Fire
description: Exploding Keg also causes your next 2 casts of Keg Smash to summon a whirl of flame which spirals outwards, dealing 70 additional Fire damage to each enemy struck.

name: Gai Plin's Imperial Brew
description: Purifying Brew instantly heals you for 25% of the Staggered damage it clears.

name: Gift of the Ox
description:
When you take damage, you have a chance to summon a Healing Sphere.

Healing Sphere:
Summon a Healing Sphere visible only to you. Moving through this Healing Sphere heals you for 117.

name: Grace of the Crane
description: Increases all healing taken by 6%.

name: Harmonic Gambit
description: During Aspect of Harmony, Rising Sun Kick, Blackout Kick, and Tiger Palm also withdraw vitality to damage enemies for an additional 20% over 8 sec.

name: Harmonic Surge
description:
Casting Thunder Focus Tea grants 2 charges of Potential Energy. Your next cast of Tiger Palm or Vivify consumes all charges of Potential Energy to cause a Harmonic Surge.

Harmonic Surge:
For each charge of Potential Energy, deal 836 Nature damage to your target and 836 Nature damage to other nearby enemies, and heal up to 5 allies for 190. Damage reduced above 5 targets.

name: Hasty Provocation
description: Provoked targets move towards you at 50% increased speed.

name: Healing Winds
description: Transcendence: Transfer immediately heals you for 10% of your maximum health.

name: Heart of the Ox
description: Mastery increased by 5%. Double this effect while Invoke Niuzao, the Black Ox is active.

name: High Impact
description: Enemies who die within 10 sec of being damaged by a Flurry Strike explode, dealing 35 physical damage to uncontrolled enemies within 8 yds.

name: High Tolerance
description: Stagger is 5% more effective at delaying damage.\n\nPurifying Brew refunds 4.0 sec of its cooldown if cast at Elevated Stagger.

name: Improved Blackout Kick
description: Blackout Kick deals 20% increased damage.

name: Improved Touch of Death
description: Touch of Death can now be used on targets with less than 15% health remaining, dealing 35% of your maximum health in damage.

name: Initiator's Edge
description: Movement speed is increased by 50% for the first 8 sec of combat.

name: Ironshell Brew
description: Increases your maximum health by an additional 10% and your damage taken is reduced by an additional 10% while Fortifying Brew is active.

name: Jade Flash
description: Crackling Jade Lightning deals its damage in 75% less time, costs 75% less Energy, and strikes 4 additional targets, but has a 60 sec cooldown.

name: Jade Walk
description: While out of combat, your movement speed is increased by 15%.

name: Light Brewing
description: Reduces the cooldown of Purifying Brew, Celestial Brew, and Celestial Infusion by 20%.

name: Lighter Than Air
description: Roll causes you to become lighter than air, allowing you to double jump to dash forward a short distance once within 5 sec, but the cooldown of Roll is increased by 2 sec.

name: Manifestation
description: Chi Burst and Chi Wave deal 50% increased damage and healing.

name: Mantra of Purity
description: When cast on yourself, your single-target healing spells heal for 10% more and restore an additional 570 health over 6 sec.

name: Mantra of Tenacity
description: Fortifying Brew grants 20% Stagger.

name: Martial Instincts
description: Increases your Physical damage done by 5% and Avoidance increased by 2%.

name: Martial Precision
description: Your attacks penetrate 12% armor.

name: Meditative Focus
description:
Blackout Combo:
Increases Tiger Palm damage by an additional 50% and Keg Smash reduces the cooldown on your Brews by an additional 1.0 sec.

  Press the Advantage:
Nature damage dealt by your main hand auto-attacks is increased by 100% and they now reduce the cooldown on your Brews by an additional 0.25 sec.

name: Mighty Stomp
description: While active, Invoke Niuzao, the Black Ox can be recast to cause Niuzao to stomp mightily and knock nearby enemies into the air.

name: Niuzao's Resolve
description: Healing Spheres now heal over 10 sec, and their healing is increased by up to 80% based on your missing health.

name: One Versus Many
description:
Auto attack critical strikes generate double the amount of Flurry Charges.


Keg Smash damage increased by 35%.

name: One With the Wind
description: You have a 10% chance to not reset your Elusive Brawler stacks after a successful dodge.

name: Overwhelming Force
description: Rising Sun Kick, Blackout Kick and Tiger Palm deal 15% additional damage to enemies in a line in front of you. Damage reduced above 5 targets.

name: Ox Stance
description: Casting Purifying Brew grants a charge of Ox Stance. When you take damage that is greater than 60% of your current health, a charge is consumed to increase the amount you Stagger.

name: Path of Resurgence
description: Chi Burst increases vitality stored by 25% for 10 sec.

name: Peace and Prosperity
description: Reduces the cooldown of Ring of Peace by 5 sec and Song of Chi-Ji's cast time is reduced by 0.5 sec.

name: Potential Energy
description: Casting Keg Smash grants a charge of Potential Energy.

name: Predictive Training
description: When you dodge or parry an attack, reduce all damage taken by 10% for the next 6 sec.

name: Press the Advantage
description: Your main hand auto attacks reduce the cooldown on your Brews by 0.50 sec and block your target's chi, dealing 10 additional Nature damage.\n\nAfter 10 attacks, the next casts Tiger Palm at 100% effectiveness.

name: Pressure Points
description: Paralysis now removes all Enrage effects from its target.

name: Pretense of Instability
description: Drinking a Brew grants you 10% dodge for 5 sec.

name: Pride of Pandaria
description: Flurry Strikes have 15% additional chance to critically strike.

name: Profound Rebuttal
description: Expel Harm's critical healing is increased by 50%.

name: Purified Spirit
description: When Aspect of Harmony ends, any remaining vitality is expelled as healing over 8 sec, split among nearby targets.

name: Quick Footed
description: The duration of snare effects on you is reduced by 20%.

name: Quick Sip
description: Purify 5% of your Staggered damage each time you gain 3 sec of Shuffle duration.

name: Reinvigoration
description: After Detox successfully removes an effect from an ally, their movement speed is increased by 30% for 5 sec.

name: Roar from the Heavens
description: Tiger's Lust grants 20% movement speed to up to 2 allies near its target.

name: Rushing Reflexes
description: Your heightened reflexes allow you to react swiftly to the presence of enemies, causing you to quickly lunge to the nearest enemy in front of you within 10 yards after you Roll.

name: Sal'salabim's Strength
description: When you use Keg Smash, the remaining cooldown on Breath of Fire is reset.

name: Save Them All
description: Your healing is increased by up to 10%, based on the current health of your target. Lower health targets are healed for more.

name: Scalding Brew
description: Keg Smash deals an additional 20% damage to targets affected by Breath of Fire.

name: Shado Over the Battlefield
description: Flurry Strikes deal 18 Nature damage to all enemies within 6 yds, reduced beyond 8 targets.

name: Shadowboxing Treads
description: Blackout Kick's damage increased by 20% and it strikes an additional 2 targets.

name: Shuffle
description:
Niuzao's teachings allow you to shuffle during combat, increasing the effectiveness of your Stagger by 100%.

Shuffle is granted by attacking enemies with your Keg Smash, Blackout Kick, and Spinning Crane Kick.

 Stagger: You shrug off attacks, delaying a portion of Physical damage based on your Agility, instead taking it over 10 sec. Affects magical attacks at 58% effectiveness.

name: Silent Sanctuary
description: While no enemies are within 15 yds, you heal for 1,140 every 3 sec.

name: Special Delivery
description: Drinking from your Brews has a 100% chance to toss a keg high into the air that lands nearby after 3 sec, dealing 35 Physical damage to all enemies within 8 yards and reducing their movement speed by 50% for 15 sec.

name: Spirit of the Ox
description:
Blackout Kick has a chance to summon a Healing Sphere.

Healing Sphere:
Summon a Healing Sphere visible only to you. Moving through this Healing Sphere heals you for 117.

name: Spirit's Essence
description: Transcendence: Transfer snares targets within 10 yds by 70% for 4 sec when cast.

name: Stagger
description: You shrug off attacks, delaying a portion of Physical damage based on your Agility, instead taking it over 10 sec. Affects magical attacks at 58% effectiveness.

name: Staggering Strikes
description: When you Blackout Kick, your Stagger is reduced by 210, increased by up to 200% based on your missing health.

name: Stand Ready
description: Activating Invoke Niuzao, the Black Ox instantly grants 10 stacks of Flurry Strikes that trigger on your next attack at 70% effectiveness.

name: Stillstep Coil
description: Leg Sweep applies Disable for 5.0 sec when it ends.

name: Stormstout's Last Keg
description: Keg Smash deals 50% additional damage to its primary target, has 1 additional charge, and its range is increased by 10 yards.

name: Strength of Spirit
description: Expel Harm's healing is increased by up to 100%, based on your missing health.

name: Swift Art
description: Roll removes a snare effect once every 30 sec.

name: Swift as a Coursing River
description: Drinking from a Brew increases your movement speed by 15% and your auto-attack speed by 10% for 15 sec.

name: Tiger Tail Sweep
description: Increases the range of Leg Sweep by 4 yds.

name: Tiger's Vigor
description: Casting Tiger's Lust reduces the remaining cooldown on Roll by 5 sec.

name: Training of Niuzao
description: Gain up to 15% Mastery based on your current level of Stagger.

name: Tranquil Spirit
description: When you consume a Healing Sphere, you clear 5% of your currently Staggered damage.

name: Veteran's Eye
description: Haste increased by 5%.

name: Vigilant Watch
description: Blackout Kick deals an additional 30% critical damage.

name: Vigorous Expulsion
description: Expel Harm's healing increased by 5% and critical strike chance increased by 15%.

name: Vital Flame
description: Heal for 40% of all Fire or Nature damage dealt by your spells and abilities.

name: Vivacious Vivification
description: After casting Rising Sun Kick, your next Vivify becomes instant cast.\n\nThis effect also reduces the energy cost of Vivify by 75%.

name: Walk with the Ox
description: Your damaging abilities have a chance to invoke Niuzao, causing him to charge to your target's location and Stomp, dealing 140 Physical damage to your target and reduced damage to secondary targets.

name: Way of a Thousand Strikes
description: Rising Sun Kick, Blackout Kick and Tiger Palm contribute 30% additional vitality.

name: Weapons of the Wall
description: Invoke Niuzao, the Black Ox's stomp damage increased by 20%.

name: Whirling Steel
description: When your health drops below 50%, summon Whirling Steel, increasing your parry chance and avoidance by 15% for 6 sec.\n\nThis effect can not occur more than once every 180 sec.

name: Wind's Reach
description: The range of Disable is increased by 5 yds.\n \nThe duration of Crashing Momentum is increased by 3 sec and its snare now reduces movement speed by an additional 20%.

name: Windwalking
description: You and your allies within 10 yards have 10% increased movement speed. Stacks with other similar effects.

name: Wisdom of the Wall
description: Invoke Niuzao, the Black Ox causes Breath of Fire to launch 3 Flurry Strikes.

name: Yu'lon's Grace
description: Find resilience in the flow of chi in battle, gaining a magic absorb shield for 1.0% of your max health every 3 sec in combat, stacking up to 10%.

name: Zen State
description: The effectiveness of your Stagger is increased by up to 15%, based on your missing health.

name: Transcendence: Transfer
description: Your body and spirit swap locations.

name: Flurry Charge
description: Your auto attacks have a chance to generate $s1-$s2 Flurry Charges. When you cast $?c3[Fists of Fury][Keg Smash], unleash all Flurry Charges, dealing $450617s1 Physical damage per charge.

name: Mastery: Elusive Brawler
description: Each time you are hit by a melee attack, or hit with Blackout Kick, you gain stacking 18.9% increased Dodge chance until your next successful Dodge.\n\nAlso increases your attack power by 20.5%.
